| R_mechs.php | Notes | Effects that refer to "ground forces" apply to mechs. | 55.1; 43 |
| R_modifiers.php | Notes | “Combat roll” modifiers do not modify anti-fighter barrage, bombardment or space cannon rolls. | 10.1c; 15.1c; 77.3d |
| R_modifiers.php | Notes | When an effect moves a unit to an adjacent system, modifying that unit's move value will have no effect. | 58.9 |
| R_movement.php | Notes | When an effect moves a unit to an adjacent system, modifying that unit's move value will have no effect. | 58.9 |
| R_movement.php | Notes | Fighters alone will block other player's ships from moving through that system, whether they are accompanied by a Space Dock or they are Fighters II. | 58.4b; FAQ section (General) |
| R_neighbors.php | Notes | A player may make a deal with any player, however, these deals may only include a transaction if the two players are neighbors. | 28.1 |
| R_neighbors.php | Notes | A player may resolve one transaction with each other player per each agenda during the agenda phase, however, the agenda phase does not make all players neighbors. | 94.6; 94.6a |
| R_objective_cards.php | Notes | A status phase objective must have its condition met during the status phase. | 61.5a |
| R_objective_cards.php | Notes | A player may score an action phase secret objective when they are not the active player. | 61.5b |
| R_pds.php | Notes | A PDS is both a structure and a unit. | 63 (intro); 63.3 |
| R_planetary_shield.php | Notes | A unit with the Planetary Shield ability on a planet does not stop of the use of a unit's Bombardment ability on other planets in the same system. | 65 |
| R_planets.php | Notes | Mecatol Rex and planets in home systems do not have traits. | 35.2b |
| R_planets.php | Notes | A planet cannot be spent for both its influence and resources during a single exhaustion. | 34.3 |
| R_producing_units.php | Notes | Whenever a unit is produced, its cost must be paid, unless the effect that is producing the unit explicitly says otherwise. | 67.1 |
| R_producing_units.php | Notes | A player cannot produce one fighter and one infantry for one resource. | 67.2 |
| R_production.php | Notes | A unit's Production value is the maximum number of units that may be produced by that unit, regardless of cost. For example, a space dock with Production 6 could produce six dreadnoughts or six fighters. | 68.1; 68.1b |
| R_production.php | Notes | Placement of produced units is not limited by a unit's Production value, only by the location of the producing units. | 68.1a; 68.3 |
| R_production.php | Notes | For example, tile 75 with Space Dock I on Abaddon and Ashtroth but not Loki: seven infantry may be placed on Abaddon, Ashtroth, or split, but not on Loki. | 68.3 |
| R_readied.php | Notes | Passive abilities on an exhausted card are still in effect while that card is exhausted. | 34.4a |
| R_readied.php | Notes | Planets will also ready at the end of each agenda phase. | 8.4 |
| R_reinforcements.php | Notes | If a player wishes to place a unit, but there are none of that type left in their reinforcements, they may remove a unit of that type from any system that does not contain one of their command tokens and place that instead. | 23.4a |
| R_rerolls.php | Notes | Effects that reroll "combat rolls" do not reroll anti-fighter barrage, bombardment or space cannon rolls. | 10.1c; 15.1c; 77 (Space Cannon) |
| R_space_cannon.php | Notes | A player may use the Sustain Damage ability of a ship in the active system to cancel a hit produced during the Space Cannon Offense step. | 87.4 |
| R_space_cannon.php | Notes | A player may use the Sustain Damage ability of a mech committed to a planet to cancel a hit produced during the Space Cannon Defense step by a unit on that planet. | 87.4 |
| R_space_combat.php | Notes | A player's fighters and ground forces do not count against capacity during combat. At the end of combat, any excess units are removed and returned to that player's reinforcements. | 16.3c |
| R_space_combat.php | Notes | While retreating, a player cannot transport more fighters and/or ground forces than they have capacity in the retreating ships. | 95 (intro) |
| R_space_combat.php | Notes | Capacity is checked after the winner of a space combat is determined. | 78.10a |
| R_space_dock.php | Notes | A Space Dock is both a structure and a unit. | 85 |
| R_space_dock.php | Notes | Fighters transported during movement remain assigned to the transporting ship until movement is complete. | 95.1a |
| R_speaker.php | Notes | During the strategy and agenda phases, the speaker will have the first opportunity to resolve abilities during each timing window. | 1.20 |
| R_status_phase.php | Notes | A player cannot score public objectives if that player does not control each planet in their home system. | 61.16 |
| R_status_phase.php | Notes | All damaged units will be repaired, even if a game effect has caused those units to no longer have the Sustain Damage ability. | 81.7 |
| R_strategy_card.php | Notes | During three- and four-player games, each player will choose two strategy cards during the strategy phase. | 84.1c |
| R_strategy_card.php | Notes | Players will use the lower of the two initiative numbers on their strategy cards to determine the initiative order. | 48.3 |
| R_trade.php | Notes | Say, for example, Alice is the active player... The full order of steps is: (with 8 sub-items: Alice gains three trade goods; Alice replenishes her commodities; Alice chooses players for the secondary; Bob, Cheng, Diego, Esther, Fahd each may/must replenish by performing the secondary ability) | 92.2; 92.3; 92.4a; 92.5; FAQ section (General): Trade secondary for free |
| R_transactions.php | Notes | Relic fragments may be traded. Relics themselves cannot be. | 94.3 |
| R_transactions.php | Notes | Captured non-fighter ships and mechs may be returned to the player that originally owned them as part of a transaction. | 17.2a; 17.4a |
| R_transactions.php | Notes | If a player becomes neighbors with another player on their turn, they may then perform a transaction with that player. | 94.1; 94.1a |
| R_transactions.php | Notes | If a player stops being neighbors with another player that they have performed a transaction with this turn, but then become neighbors with that player again later that same turn, they cannot perform a second transaction with that player. | 94.1 |
| R_transactions.php | Notes | If a player may perform multiple actions on their turn, they may still only resolve one transaction with each of their neighbors. | 94.1 |
| R_transport.php | Notes | A ship may transport units in its system as it retreats or is otherwise moved out of the active system. | LRR v2.0 FAQ section, General (p. 41); 78.7b |
| R_transport.php | Notes | A ship cannot pick up more units from a planet than it has capacity. | 95 (intro) |
| R_units.php | Notes | Units are component limited. | 23.4 |
| R_units.php | Notes | Fighters and infantry are semi-limited, via the use of tokens. | 23.4b |
| R_wormholes.php | Notes | A system cannot be adjacent to itself, even if it has multiple wormholes in it. | 6.2a |

## Rulings that conflict with an item on the site (not changed)

- Muaat: Nova Seed on Avernus system purges Avernus: FAQ says faction-specific tokens are returned to their owner rather than purged; the Avernus token is a Muaat faction component, so CC's 'purged' contradicts the FAQ (arguable, since the FAQ predates TE).
- elim-nekro-flagship: Ruling depends on the eliminated player's faction sheet staying in play; LRR 33.2 returns the faction sheet to the game box.
- elim-galvanize: Ruling explicitly keeps the eliminated Bastion faction sheet in play; LRR 33.2 returns the faction sheet to the game box. Coordinator may choose to add only the token effect if this is judged an exception like LRR 33.10.
- elim-share-knowledge: LRR 33.4a returns the eliminated player's promissory notes to the game box immediately, even if another player has them.
- elim-sever: LRR 33.4a returns the eliminated player's promissory notes to the game box; the ruling also keeps the Crimson faction sheet in play, contrary to LRR 33.2. The breach-token half of this ruling is recorded separately (elim-breaches).
- elim-crimson-home: Ruling keeps the eliminated Rebellion faction sheet in play; LRR 33.2 returns it to the game box.
- coex-hazardous-coexisting-infantry: Contradicted by DQA ('You cannot spend other player’s units to pay for explore cards’ costs.'). The explore half of this ruling is already covered (R_coexistence, DQA,CC).
- Retreat: ground forces only taken if picked up at Announce Retreat (07/18/2018): Codex 1 (CX1) states the player need not decide which ground forces to transport until the retreat is executed.
- Minister of Industry not triggered by replacing a space dock (10/02/2018): FAQ (doc1 l.42) treats "replace" as "remove and place" and explicitly says this overturns a previous ruling regarding Minister of Industry.
- Ship destroyed by gravity rift entering lone Saar dock system still destroys dock (11/23/2018): Current LRR rolls immediately before the ship exits the rift, so the ship is removed before it ever enters the dock's system; Dane also flagged the ruling as likely to be overturned.
- Mentak cannot pillage Creuss via wormhole adjacency (12/10/2018): LRR makes the Creuss and Mentak neighbors in this case and allows Pillage.
- Mentak cannot pillage Creuss on Creuss turn via opposite wormhole (12/11/2018): Contradicted by LRR.
- Unstable Planet may be played on an exhausted planet (1/25/2019): LRR v2.0 (newer) keeps rule 2.6a/22.3 and 34.4 ("If a card is already exhausted, it cannot be exhausted again"); with the LRR's errata'd text ("Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry") the ability cannot be completely resolved on an exhausted planet. Judgment call; flagged conservatively.
- Returned secret objective (repealed Classified Document Leaks) counts only for owner (1/25/2019): LRR says the objective is not returned and does not count toward the original owner's total.
- Retreat ground forces pick-up restriction (1/25/2019 repost, l.489): Duplicate of 07/18/2018 entry; contradicted by Codex 1.
- Jimb0v Oct 18 2017 transactions with non-neighbor active player: Question is missing; as written it contradicts LRR 94.1 / 60.1 (transactions only with neighbors outside the agenda phase). If it meant deals, R_deals.php already covers that (LRR).
- Clipper Aug 24 2018 roll rift for carrier destroyed by fleet supply: LRR v2.0 41.2 moved the gravity rift roll to immediately before the ship exits the rift, i.e. before it reaches the active system and before fleet supply is checked; Dane flagged this for revision in V2.
- sigmazero13 Jan 18 2018 Nekro loses war sun tech: LRR 90.20 says the war suns are returned to reinforcements, not destroyed (matters for 'when destroyed' triggers). Substance otherwise already on the site.
- Clipper Mar 12 2018 fleet supply before gravity rift roll: LRR v2.0 41.2 has the rift roll occur as each ship exits the rift, before it arrives in the active system, so it precedes the fleet supply check.
- 0 hr Jul 18 2018 retreat ground forces must be picked up at announce: Codex I 'Retreating with Infantry' removed the announce-step pickup; ground forces are transported as normal when the ships retreat.
- MattProv3 Aug 28 2018 gravity rift roll after all ships moved: LRR v2.0 41.2 changed the roll timing to immediately before each ship exits the rift.
- CreussEmissary Oct 31 2018 retreat units selected before combat round: Superseded by Codex I retreat streamlining.
- Clipper Oct 31 2018 retreat with partial capacity losses takes a subset: Premise (units chosen at announce step) superseded by Codex I; under current rules units are chosen when the retreat executes.
- hooliganj Jan 25 2019 returned secret objective after Classified Document Leaks repealed: LRR v2.0 FAQ: the objective is not returned and does not count toward the original owner's total.
- reddit 2019 faction promissory notes with implied costs resolvable without tokens: The ruling rests on old 1.15 being 'timing, not obligation'; LRR v2.0 1.17 now reads 'must resolve the effect that occurs before the word then or they cannot resolve the effect that occurs after', which contradicts it. Site items F_lizix/F_xxcha follow the earlier DR ruling consistent with LRR v2.0.

## Rulings reviewed and not added

- DQA Twilight's Fall: When you splice: Twilight's Fall content; the site has no pages or sections for Twilight's Fall components, so there is nowhere appropriate to place it.
- DQA Twilight's Fall: Calamitas secondary cost: Twilight's Fall content; the site has no pages or sections for Twilight's Fall components, so there is nowhere appropriate to place it. (Effectively an erratum for the Twilight's Fall #6 strategy card.)
- DQA Twilight's Fall: Calamitas build/splice order: Twilight's Fall content; the site has no pages or sections for Twilight's Fall components, so there is nowhere appropriate to place it. Answer is also a non-committal suggestion.
- DQA Twilight's Fall: Temporal Command Suite cost: Concerns the Twilight's Fall version (3-influence cost) and approves an async house rule as a temporary band-aid; not a ruling.
- DQA Twilight's Fall: Yssaril Guild Agents trigger: Twilight's Fall content; the site has no pages or sections for Twilight's Fall components, so there is nowhere appropriate to place it.
- Muaat: Avernus remains if Muaat eliminated: duplicate of the same ruling proposed from the rules section (kept there)
- Rebellion: breaches remain on elimination: duplicate of the same Incursion ruling proposed from the rules section (kept there)
- Rebellion: Sever token remains on elimination: conflicts with LRR 33.4a (an eliminated player's promissory notes are removed from the game)
- Sol: produced ship need not survive fleet pool for extra infantry Production: the ruling does not name the card it applies to; placement under Bellum Gloriosum would be a guess
- Deepwrought: Ocean cards are planet cards (duplicate): Duplicate of the earlier Ocean card ruling in the same section; included in that entry's html.
- Deepwrought: Ocean cards not planets for objectives (duplicate): Duplicate of the earlier Ocean card ruling in the same section; included in that entry's html.
- Alliance mode: Nekro ally draws on starting tech: The Alliance game variant is not covered by the site. If wanted, it could go under Nekro Acidos: 'In the Alliance game variant, commanders are unlocked during setup before starting technologies are gained, so the Nekro player's ally draws action cards when they gain their starting technologies.'
- fracture-dmz: Answer is simply to resolve the card normally; no new rule content.
- Experimental Battlestation: any effect that moves ships; space cannon on play (11/13/2018): Superseded by Dane's Nov 14, 2018 ruling (doc4 l.1477-1489): only the move step of the tactical action, part of Space Cannon Offense, active player only. Site already reflects the later ruling (C_action_cards.php Experimental Battlestation).
- Creuss ability marked for LRR v2 review (12/11/2018): Commentary only; no ruling.
- Unstable Planet not playable on exhausted planet (01/13/2019): Superseded by Dane's 1/25/2019 ruling (which itself conflicts with the LRR; see next entry).
- PDS can fire at moving Saar dock (Dec 29 2017 #5): Superseded by Dane's Jan 5, 2018 ruling (doc4 l.1010) and contradicted by the LRR FAQ: Floating Factories cannot be the target of PDS fire (F_saar.php).
- Nekro losing Prototype War Sun II / Floating Factory II (Sep 18 2017 #7): DR says the units are "destroyed"; the site item follows LRR 90.19–90.20 ("returned to reinforcements")
- CreussEmissary May 24 2018 Splicer design commentary: Design commentary, no rule.
- 0 hr Jun 6 2018 action card discard pile faceup and viewable: duplicate of the same ruling from the first half of the document (kept there, with FAQ added)
- TomBoombs Oct 3 2018 replacing a space dock does not trigger Minister of Industry: overturned by the FAQ ("this overturns a previous ruling regarding Minister of Industry")
- CreussEmissary Oct 31 2018 flowchart image: Ruling content is an external image not in the text; the retreat pickup timing it illustrates was superseded by Codex I.
- Yin4Life Apr 22 2019 Rise of a Messiah with more planets than infantry: Premise outdated: LRR v2.0 23.4 makes ground forces not component-limited (infantry tokens) and says abilities cannot force a player to remove and place units; the ruling's forced removal would muddy that. Not safe to add.
- unanswered L1Z1X/Sol infinite-turn question: Question only; no answer recorded.

- RulesPal arborec-mitosis-one-infantry: Restates the Mitosis faction ability text (one infantry on one planet).
- RulesPal classified-document-leaks: RP says that if the law is discarded the card returns to its owner as a secret; the LRR item says it is not returned. The rest of the entry (public while leaked, owner cannot score again, does not count toward the limit) is already covered with RP.
- RulesPal minister-of-sciences-technology: Restates the Minister of Sciences card text (no resources spent when researching via the Technology card).
- RulesPal conventions-of-war: RP says X-89 can still be used on cultural planets under Conventions of War; that reflects the original X-89 component action. The Codex X-89 Bacterial Weapon versions modify bombardment, which Conventions of War forbids against cultural planets. Remaining text is voting strategy.
- RulesPal faction-war-sun-objectives: Duplicate of faction-units-count-as-base-type (proposed R_units note covers the Prototype War Sun counting as a war sun).
- RulesPal revealed-unmet-secret-objective: Non-committal: RulesPal states there is no rule for it and describes common practice.
- RulesPal capacity-during-combat: RP says a side left with only unsupported fighters has them removed and the combat counts as a draw; the LRR item determines the winner before capacity is checked. The rest (no capacity check during combat) is already covered with RP.
- RulesPal after-skilled-retreat-attacker-continues: Foresight continuing to Space Cannon Offense is already covered (DR,RP). The claim that Skilled Retreat leaves no combat winner is doubtful against the LRR winner definition (player with ships remaining wins), so it is not proposed.
- RulesPal failed-invasion-ships-stay: Rulebook restatement; nothing removes ships, and blockade rules already cover the space dock.
- RulesPal fighters-cannot-invade: Rulebook restatement; only ground forces can be committed (LRR Commit Ground Forces item).
- RulesPal fleet-pool-reduction-destroyed: The LRR (Fleet Pool) says excess ships are removed and returned to reinforcements, not destroyed; the 'destroyed' premise contradicts it. The point that the player causing the reduction gets no destroy credit is consistent but follows from removal.
- RulesPal private-negotiations: Non-committal; left to the group.
- RulesPal three-way-transactions: Derived consequence of the existing transaction and deal rules; no new ruling.
- RulesPal gravity-drive-one-ship: Restates the card text (one ship per tactical action).
- RulesPal muaat-prototype-war-sun-ii-cost: Restates the printed unit cost.
- RulesPal saar-dock-not-blockadable-objective: Does not name a specific objective; the underlying rule (Floating Factory destroyed when blockaded) is already on F_saar.
- RulesPal sabotage-what-it-cancels: Restates the Sabotage card text.
- RulesPal parley-ground-forces-return: Restates the Parley card text; the capacity consequence is the general capacity rule.
- RulesPal parley-timing: Follows from the card timing and the invasion step order already on R_invasion.
- RulesPal combat-cards-only-own-units: Non-committal summary of individual card texts; no single ruling.
- RulesPal creuss-iff-placement: Restates the either/or placement text of the Creuss IFF card.
- RulesPal arborec-stymie-home-system: Restates the 'non-home system' wording of the card; unclear which Stymie version the answer describes.

- RulesPal creuss-wormhole-token-limit: Component question; also inconsistent with the Wormhole Generator answer about which tokens exist.
